classification: Source-known, retrospective extension; fixed before running this diagnostic, after the 64 XOR outputs were available
scope: Apply structure checks only to the same 64 hex-decoded-cookie XOR outputs in cases.json. This does not supply the undefined raw-cookie arm.
source_pkcs_helper: Call pinned zerofp_tests.pkcs1_v15_check on each 32-byte output: prefix 00 01, at least one FF byte, then 00. Report its exact predicate, not a generic RSA validity verdict.
strict_pkcs_control: Separately count prefix 00 01 followed by at least eight FF bytes and then 00; this is a diagnostic stricter than the source helper.
source_named_digest: Check the one unused H-03 source-code target an_end_prefix20 = 36367763ab73313a5ce0cd854ba3d6a39e4b8770 as an exact byte substring in each 32-byte output. Do not claim a sweep of all known 3301 hashes/strings.
positive_controls: One synthetic 32-byte block beginning 00 01 + eight FF bytes + 00 must pass both PKCS predicates.
One synthetic 32-byte block containing the exact source named 20-byte AN END prefix must be detected.
failure_interpretation: No hits would exclude only these exact structures in the 64 fixed outputs. It would not test unspecified targets, encodings, raw-cookie rules or cryptographic use of cookies.
